data.summary: The independent validation report for CR-002 Random-forest PD challenger has been completed, resulting in an overall rating of Not fit for use. The model passed all performance and calibration checks, including Discrimination (Gini) on test and oot, as well as Calibration (predicted ÷ observed). However, it received an amber status for Input stability train → oot (CSI) — `purpose` and `age.in.years`, and a red status for the Monotonicity check. Key findings include a hardcoded file path and the model's use of every column, which raises concerns regarding its robustness.
